title: Multi-Lane Echelon / Tandem Snowplows Clearing Highway Diagonal-Abreast: NEVER Pass Between Snowplows!

no_head_on_same_lane.note: Plows face south toward camera while cars face north away; they are in adjacent lanes, not the exact same lane, so no same-lane head-on pair.

no_rhd_cabin.note: No car interior or steering wheel is visible; only exterior windshields.

single_bulb_signal.note: No traffic signal is present in the scene.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Yellow line on image-left, white edge/guardrail on image-right implies northbound travel; background cars go north correctly but both foreground plows face south toward camera, i.e. wrong-way for those markings.

zero_text.note: No letters, numbers, or words visible; plow top signs and plates are blank dark shapes.

scene_match.note: Two orange plows staggered with red X between them is present, but cars show rears facing away while plows show fronts facing toward camera, so cars read as ahead/oncoming rather than trailing far behind plows.

result.summary: Plows drive wrong-way toward camera opposite trailing traffic, failing US right-hand traffic and teaching the echelon concept backwards despite correct zero-text and X symbol.

teaching_correct.note: Learner sees plows moving opposite to cars and cars positioned ahead of plows, opposite of 'plows lead, traffic stays far behind'; teaches wrong-way / wrong following geometry.

result.what_i_see: Two orange snowplows in the foreground face toward the camera pushing snow, with a large red X between them, while four cars in the background show rear taillights facing away on a snowy multi-lane highway at sunset.
